name: Konsole
summary: KDE's default terminal. Profiles (.profile) and color schemes (.colorscheme) are plain INI files; tabs, split view, translucency with KWin blur, background wallpaper, Sixel images. No ligatures, shaders or quake mode (Yakuake is the KDE drop-down).

windows.notes: Konsole is a KDE/Linux app; the source has Windows and macOS code paths but no supported builds were confirmed here.

install.notes: Flatpak keeps its data under ~/.var/app/org.kde.konsole/, so the paths below are for the native package. Unverified here.

linux.notes: Profiles and color schemes live in $XDG_DATA_HOME/konsole (default ~/.local/share/konsole); the handbook states profiles are saved there. A profile is NAME.profile, a color scheme is NAME.colorscheme; the profile selects the scheme with ColorScheme=NAME (file basename). The default profile is konsolerc [Desktop Entry] DefaultProfile=NAME.profile. Prefer kwriteconfig6 over hand-editing konsolerc (shared KDE config that a running Konsole may rewrite). There is no config validator; `konsole --list-profiles` lists the profiles Konsole can parse. Konsole 24.02+ is Qt6/KF6; Font strings differ between Qt5 and Qt6 builds (weight 50 vs 400).

ligatures.notes: No ligature option in the profile keys read from Profile.cpp or in the handbook. Use kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty or iTerm2 for ligatures.

font-fallback.notes: No fallback list. Konsole uses the system (fontconfig) fallback; the profile has a separate EmojiFont key (Appearance). Unverified that a symbols-only font is picked automatically for Private Use glyphs, so use a patched Nerd Font as the main font.

background-animated.notes: Wallpaper is a static image. Use kitty (custom shaders), Ghostty or WezTerm.

shader.notes: No shader support. Use Ghostty or kitty.

quake.notes: Konsole has no drop-down mode. The KDE drop-down terminal is Yakuake, a separate app that embeds Konsole and uses Konsole profiles and color schemes.
